appraisal_events.evidence: allez où vous voudrez, n'importe où, excepté chez Mme Verdurin. Il faut à tout prix en éloigner demain Albertine... ce qui est possible, c'est que je vienne avec vous. — Ah ! fit Andrée d'une voix fort ennuyée et comme effrayée de mon audace, qui ne fit du reste que s'en affermir
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator issues peremptory instructions to Andrée over the telephone and then imposes himself on her plans with Albertine; Andrée's frightened, annoyed reaction only hardens his resolve, showing him overriding her will.

status_effects.explanation: Andrée is visibly startled and made uneasy by the narrator's audacious insistence on joining her and Albertine, and yields to it rather than resisting.
The narrator successfully imposes his will on Andrée despite her evident discomfort, his audacity growing firmer precisely because of her fright rather than being checked by it.
